modmenu.descriptionTranslation.worldarch: Creates dependable local backups of your single-player worlds.
screen.worldarchive.cleanup.choose: Choose which backups to delete from this computer. Copies on your Git remote are kept and stay listed; use Delete to remove one from the remote.
screen.worldarchive.delete.labeled: %s of them have a label. A label does not protect a backup from Delete.
screen.worldarchive.delete.prompt_many: Delete these %s backups from every destination? You cannot undo this.
screen.worldarchive.delete.prompt_one: Delete this backup from every destination? You cannot undo this.
screen.worldarchive.delete.remote_many: %s of them have a copy on your Git remote. Those copies are deleted too.
screen.worldarchive.delete.remote_one: Its copy on your Git remote is deleted too.
screen.worldarchive.import.read_failed: Those backups could not be read, so nothing was changed: %s
screen.worldarchive.import.stopped: Import stopped: %s. Some selected backups may already be imported. Go Back and check before you try again.
screen.worldarchive.operation.stopped: The operation stopped before it finished
screen.worldarchive.operation.sync_cance: The backup on this computer did not change. Choose Sync to try again.
screen.worldarchive.restore.leaves_world: This leaves the world you are playing.
screen.worldarchive.storage.not_counted: copies on your Git remote or in linked folders are not counted
screen.worldarchive.storage.save_first: Save the policy first; cleanup uses the saved limit
screen.worldarchive.operation.cancelled_: Partial files are being removed. A destination that had already finished is kept.
screen.worldarchive.settings.defaults_re: Defaults restored; choose Save to apply them
screen.worldarchive.settings.folder_pick: The native folder picker failed; type an absolute path instead
screen.worldarchive.settings.git_enabled: Enable Git and Git LFS backups
screen.worldarchive.settings.health_chec: Checking Git, Git LFS, and destination folders...
screen.worldarchive.settings.no_worlds: No worlds were found in the saves folder.
screen.worldarchive.settings.notice.copy: %s is a copy of %s, so it now has its own backup history
screen.worldarchive.settings.notice.repl: %s now has a different WorldArchive identity, so its old world settings were not carried over
screen.worldarchive.settings.notice.shar: %s carry the same WorldArchive identity. Open the world that should keep its backup history first
screen.worldarchive.settings.notice.unre: %s is left out: its WorldArchive identity could not be read (%s)
screen.worldarchive.settings.path_hint: Full folder path on this computer
screen.worldarchive.settings.remote_name: The Git remote name (usually origin). Set each world's repository URL on the Worlds tab.
screen.worldarchive.settings.reset_done: Settings were reset. The old file was kept as %s
screen.worldarchive.settings.reset_not_n: The settings file can be read again, so nothing was reset.
screen.worldarchive.settings.schedule_in: Minutes between automatic backups (applies to Git and ZIP)
screen.worldarchive.settings.title: WorldArchive Settings
screen.worldarchive.settings.unreadable_: Backups are paused, and nothing is saved over %s until it can be read. Fix the file and open this screen again, or choose Reset settings: the old file is kept, and the settings start over from the defaults.
Settings could not be read: a newer WorldArchive saved them. Update WorldArchive, or reset the settings.
Settings could not be read: they are from WorldArchive 0.1.0, which this version no longer reads. Reset the settings, then use Import with the old Git repository to bring back its backups.
screen.worldarchive.settings.validation_: Settings validation failed; review the destination paths
screen.worldarchive.settings.world_remot: Paste the address of this world's Git repository. Each new backup uploads to it. If an upload fails, choose Sync on that backup to try again.
screen.worldarchive.settings.world_zip_t: Optional folder for this world's ZIP backups. If not selected, the folder from the ZIP tab is used.
screen.worldarchive.worlds.title: World Backups
screen.worldarchive.browser.create_world: Backups are off for this world. Turn them on in Settings, on the Worlds tab.
screen.worldarchive.browser.create_no_de: No destination takes manual backups. Turn one on in Settings.
screen.worldarchive.browser.create_git_m: Only Git takes manual backups, and Git or Git LFS is missing. Install both, or turn on ZIP backups.
screen.worldarchive.browser.create_stora: A backup folder is inside a world, so backups are paused. Choose another folder in Settings.
screen.worldarchive.operation.restore_ca: The partial world copy was removed. No world was changed.
screen.worldarchive.runtime.settings_unr: WorldArchive settings could not be read (%s), so backups are paused. Open Settings to fix or reset them.
screen.worldarchive.runtime.loading: WorldArchive is still loading. Try again in a moment.
screen.worldarchive.runtime.world_unavai: The world folder is not available for a new backup. Open the world list again.
screen.worldarchive.runtime.busy: A backup of this world is already running. Try again when it finishes.
screen.worldarchive.runtime.world_loadin: This world is still loading. Try again in a moment.
screen.worldarchive.runtime.world_not_sa: The settings could not record this world's folder. Open WorldArchive settings to check them.
screen.worldarchive.notice.exit_started: Creating backup... Keep Minecraft open until it finishes.
screen.worldarchive.notice.exit_done: Backup finished. You can safely quit Minecraft.
screen.worldarchive.notice.exit_warnings: Backup made, but a destination had a problem. Open Backups to see which.
screen.worldarchive.notice.exit_failed: Backup failed. Your world was saved. Open Backups to see why.
screen.worldarchive.notice.exit_skipped: Backup skipped. Your world was saved.
screen.worldarchive.notice.exit_cancelle: Backup cancelled. Your world was saved.
screen.worldarchive.notice.save_missing: The game closed before it saved the world, so no backup was made.
screen.worldarchive.notice.exit_interrup: Minecraft closed before the world-exit backup finished, so that backup was not made.
screen.worldarchive.notice.work_interrup: Minecraft closed before WorldArchive finished its work. Check your backups.
screen.worldarchive.notice.scheduled_war: Scheduled backup made, but a destination had a problem
screen.worldarchive.notice.scheduled_fai: Scheduled backup failed. Open Backups to see why.
